§6Nitra§f

§aRed dust from killing things. Your guns will thank you.§f

Nitra is obtained by killing mobs with a weapon that has the §bPainsaw§f ability (chainsaw, etc.). It can't be found naturally.

The amount depends on mob max health. An Iron Golem drops §e10§f small piles + §e10§f XP. Almost every mob drops at least 1 small pile. You can also buy §e4§f Nitra for §e16§f caps at the Bobmazon.

Conversion: §e4§f Small Piles = §e1§f Nitra (and vice versa).

Uses: §bStimpak§f (3 Small Piles + Metal Syringe = heals 2.5 hearts, shapeless) and §bAmmo Container§f (4 Nitra = ammo for 3 random guns).

Crafted ammo containers differ from found ones: they can't give expensive ammo (mini nukes, .35), come in blue instead of military green, and yield half as much ammo.

§ePS:§f Farm Nitra by killing passive mobs with an Electric Chainsaw. Set up a mob farm with Painsaw weapons for continuous income.
